title: Data Analyst, Reporting
description:

Kestrel Metrics is a Berlin scale-up helping 400 independent grocers plan smarter. We are 120 people and growing.

Two or more years in an analytics or reporting role
Strong SQL; you think in joins
Business-fluent English, as our team works in English
German at B2 or higher is a plus
Experience with dbt or Airflow

🎁 What we offer
Flexible hours, 30 days of holiday, a Deutschlandticket and a learning budget of 1,000 EUR.
